tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is dark tanned leather and is the default; Day follows prefers-color-scheme: light. Set <meta name=theme-color> to this value per theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panels, sheets, list groups, the body of a Satchel card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, hovered rows, the second level of raise. Every text color here passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, balances, the wordmark. 12:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: fiat equivalents, timestamps, helper copy. 5.5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brass, the logo tile. Primary button fill, selected tab indicator, the owned-Satchel stitch, the Listed state. One brass fill per screen. In Day add a 1px brand-deep border to brass buttons.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Top of the brass gradient, hover on primary buttons, the stitch on leather.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the brass gradient, pressed primary buttons, the brass-button border in Day (3.9:1 on ground). Not for text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brass. The same leather ink as the logo's S: 7.7:1 on brand, 10.4:1 on brand-bright.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons. 8.9:1 on Night ground, 5.8:1 on Day ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Active state and success: Sent, Confirmed, Clean history. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: frozen
tokens.usage: Frozen while listed or in cooldown, and in-progress signing. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: failed signature, unspent signature found, Revoke.

tokens.name: chain-btc
tokens.usage: Bitcoin chip dot and balance accent. Graphics only (3:1+), never text.

tokens.name: chain-evm
tokens.usage: Ethereum and EVM chip dot and balance accent.

tokens.name: chain-sol
tokens.usage: Solana chip dot and balance accent.

tokens.name: leather-light
tokens.usage: Logo only: top of the S strap gradient. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: leather-dark
tokens.usage: Logo only: bottom of the S strap gradient. Do not use in UI.

families.mono: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark ships as outlines (satchel-wordmark.svg). Bricolage Grotesque Bold, opsz 96.

styles.name: balance-hero
styles.usage: Total value on a Satchel card and the Wallet tab. 36px below 480px. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and the Satchel name. 24px below 480px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sell or gift this Satchel and the new owner controls every address in it.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Max line length 68ch.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Fiat equivalents, timestamps, helper text. ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, status pills. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Addresses, transaction hashes, payload hashes only. Middle-truncate; full value in title and aria-label; copy button beside it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, pills, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 768px, panel padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop, gap between groups, page gutter at 768px+.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing, gap between Satchel cards in the grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top margin on desktop, space above the hero card.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chain chips, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list groups, dropdowns, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The Satchel card (1.586:1), dialogs and bottom sheets. The logo tile uses the same 22% corner ratio.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills (Active, Frozen, Listed) and the segmented tab control.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Satchel card only. Other surfaces use color steps, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the wallet-connect modal, bottom sheets on mobile.

tokens.name: stitch-width
tokens.usage: The saddle stitch: a dashed brand line inset 8px inside owned containers (Satchel card edge, mint preview). The logo's S carries the same stitch.

tokens.name: stitch-dash
tokens.usage: Stitch dash pattern. brand at 45% on Night, brand-deep at 60% on Day.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phones above this get desktop type sizes for balance-hero and title.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets become centered dialogs; gutter goes to space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Side navigation appears; My Satchels grid goes to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: My Satchels and Market grid go to 3 columns.

tokens.name: container-flow
tokens.usage: Max width for task flows: Send, Sell, Mint, Connect.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width for the app shell and card grids.
